description: Fast CMO feed list with status counts and the actions available on each row (with their arguments). Each row prints BOTH ids: `feed_item #<id>` addresses the review card (autowhisper_action) while `content: <type> #<id>` addresses the content itself (autowhisper_edit_content).

autowhisper_token.description: Optional: your AutoWhisper API token, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

status.description: Filter by feed status (pending / approved / rejected / executed / all).

workspace_id.description: Workspace to read. Omit for the user's CURRENT workspace — other workspaces are NOT included. Get other ids from autowhisper_status.

name: autowhisper_feed
